notes: Screens: deleting a screen deletes the widgets on it too (it says how many and asks first) – no need to remove them one by one
Screens: in the list on the left, a bigger ✕ to delete, with a gap after ▲ ▼; and a red “Delete this screen” button at the top of each screen
Family Calendar on a computer (and the Configurator’s Calendar tab): a Year view – a wall planner with a row for each month; click a day to open that month
Children’s points cards: no scroll bars – they scroll by touch, with a small ⌄⌄ / ⌃⌃ tab when there’s more below or above
